answer: A newcomer is admitted only after three established attestors countersign it and each locks a slashable bond for four epochs. If clustering later places that key in a knoll of near-duplicate funding paths or answers, every related bond is seized. The protocol also posts each payout delta versus the cohort median; clones that merely mirror one source fall below the floor and trigger the same slash. The attacker must recruit independent risk-bearing attestors and immobilize their capital for the full window. Cheap extra keys add no standing, and one exposed farm burns every bonded signature.
